desc:
This is CRASH STUDIO AIR! ✈️
most realistic plane crash game on roblox with features as Ground crew and more!

thank you Dartosz100, minwdev, MartyMcfly, Alex for helping with the project 💖
game was created by Hungry_meelon 🍈🍉

⚠️to run the game you need at least 6gb of ram but we recommend having 8gb ram minimal

People that made videos about this game:
-AERIN
-ClipmakingBoss
-Wes
we hope to see more soon 🔥

aircrafts in game ✈️
-737 family
-a320 family
-ejets family (to be remade 🖌️)
-707 (to be remade 🖌️)
-757 (remake next update 🔥)
-747 (to be remade 🖌️)
-SNAAP300 (to be remade 🖌️)
and more...

like the game to show your support and enjoy crash studio air! 😍

#planecrash #aviation
